limitations: This audit did not observe or reproduce the browser/model run. Supplied DOM/lifecycle captures record the native execution; pure copier/replay checks prove archive consistency and contract validity, not authenticity of production.

Matching local PDF bytes and archived text/geometry does not authenticate full NVIDIA report lineage or reparse the PDF. Physical excerpt pages 1/2 have PDF labels 3/4; they are not the complete report.
Embedding vectors/token IDs and query vectors pass identity/ranking contracts, but this audit does not perform tokenizer roundtrip, encoder inference or semantic question/vector correspondence.

The full native receipt records 1,745 input IDs, 33 output IDs and EOS with disposal. This audit does not re-decode token IDs or run Qwen. Pure preflight/output inspection generationMode not-run is distinct from the full native receipt native-run.

E4 quote contains the requested date, In millions and 16,599 in a comprehensive-income statement; citation identity/quote mapping alone does not establish financial entailment, column interpretation, correctness, human gold acceptance or a quality score.
The first preparation terminal/cause remains unknown, and the first generation GEN_TIMEOUT timer branch/cause remains unestablished. Both observations are preserved without retrospective inference.
The later preparation is entirely cache verification with zero network bytes/external reads. SDK verified body/read totals are sealed local-consumption accounting, not six wire downloads.
The completed public transport-module identity does not establish a complete served module/network graph because the capture event buffer was truncated.
One native generation elapsed value and eight monotonic stage offsets are a single observation, not throughput, latency distribution, regression benchmark or production readiness.
No deployment, CI, hosted API, expanded-corpus, new wheel, security, source rights, legal redistribution or user mastery acceptance is established by this archive audit.
